pages: Service like you’ve never seen before Generac’s TechPro App brings convenience and efficiencies to the way you service and support your consumers. This tablet-based program provides technicians the ability to have all their Generac generator service information at their fingertips. Annual cost of $99.00 per download to increase productivity of your staff! (No Monthly Fee) Key Features: You now have the ability to scan or type in the product serial number to quickly access the following generator information: • Activate and register the generator and transfer switch • Receive service bulletins • Access to Diagnostic Manuals and other support documents • View and submit warranty claims and expiration information • View factory technician notes and field technician notes from previous visits Download TechPro Today! • Must have an active Generac Service Account and Technician ID Number • App can be downloaded using an Apple IPAD with an operating system 9.0 or newer and requires WiFi or Cellular connection • Download by purchasing TechPro from GenService (Part Number: G0071060 new sign up G0071070 renewal) • Your TechPro Login will be the same as your GenService Login For Questions, email techpro@generac.com
